name: 法国人才居留卡—合格雇员
nameEn: France talent residence permit — qualified employee
summary: 面向取得法国符合条件学历并获得超过三个月、达到相应薪酬标准工作合同的合格雇员。
summaryEn: For qualified employees with an eligible French qualification and a work contract exceeding three months that meets the applicable pay rule.

qualification.summary: 合格雇员路线要求在法国取得指定专业硕士、理学硕士或至少同等于硕士的学历。
qualification.summaryEn: The qualified-employee route requires a specified French advanced qualification or a qualification at least equivalent to a master's degree.

jobOffer.summary: 须有期限超过三个月的法国工作合同。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A French employment contract lasting more than three months is required.

salary.summary: 合同工资须达到申请时该人才子类别的法定门槛。
salary.summaryEn: Contract pay must meet the statutory threshold for this talent subcategory at the time of application.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
